llm.label: ML & NLP papers
llm.note: 36 arXiv papers. Calibrated: at 0.0 the gate wrongly refuses 1 of 66 answerable questions (1.5%) and catches 9 of 18 adversarial. Lowering costs more catching than it recovers here, which is why this corpus kept the value the whole project was built on.

birds.label: Ornithology
birds.note: 45 Wikipedia documents, mixed .docx/.pptx/.xlsx/.pdf. Calibrated 2026-08-21: at the ML value of 0.0 this corpus wrongly refuses 10 of 26 answerable questions (38.5%). At -3 it catches exactly as many adversarial cases and recovers six of them for nothing.

quant.label: Quantitative finance
quant.note: 35 arXiv q-fin papers. Recalibrated 2026-08-26 after the golden set was rewritten: -6, -5 and -4 all catch every one of the six adversarial cases and wrongly refuse the same three of thirty-five, so the shipped -4 stands. At 0.0 it would refuse eleven. The earlier note claimed 0.0 refused nineteen of thirty-five; that was measured against a golden set asking textbook definitional questions this corpus never answers, and those questions scored low because they were unanswerable, not because the threshold was wrong. Answerable questions now score a median of +2.34, against -0.38 before.
